title: LOAM
description: Grown, not made. An interactive 3D macro experience through living mycelium networks: scroll descends from the fruiting mushroom into the subterranean web that LOAM cultivates into custom molded packaging.
stack: Next.js 16 · React 19 · Three.js WebGL · GSAP · Lenis

sections.title: The fruit (hook)
sections.summary: One parasol mushroom (*Macrolepiota procera*) on dark, mossy forest floor in macro framing with drifting spore motes. "What you see is the smallest part." (Inspectable: mushroom).

sections.title: Under the cap (insight)
sections.summary: Camera tilts up beneath the gills; spores fall past the lens. "A mushroom is only the fruit. The organism lives underground."

sections.title: Breaking ground (transition)
sections.summary: Ant-farm soil cross-section descent through leaf litter, humus, topsoil with thick tree roots, into subsoil clay.

sections.title: The network (signature)
sections.summary: - **4a (close clump):** Close on a fist-sized mycelium clump binding soil and bark. (Inspectable: clump).

sections.title: The material (product)
sections.summary: Subterranean threads converge and resolve into LOAM's molded packaging tray. Studio lighting lifts; supporting product forms slide into view; 3-step lifecycle strip ("Grown in 7 days", "Protects in transit", "Composts back to soil"). (Inspectable: tray with broken corner).

sections.title: Return (conversion)
sections.summary: Camera ascends back through the soil to the surface; a ring of newly fruited mushrooms surrounds the first. Request a sample kit form with local validation and animated sprouting mushroom success.
